title: Surrey development applications — non-closed status snapshot

selection.meaning: Applications whose published status is not Concluded, Closed, Cancelled, Rejected or Error. This is an explicit local filter, not an official active-project flag. Included status may describe review, approvals, occupancy or maintenance; it does not establish construction progress. No date field is available to filter recent applications.
selection.finalStatusCheck: After complete ID retrieval, exclude matching final status labels case-insensitively after trimming whitespace; retained source labels remain verbatim.

geometryMeaning: Application site boundaries, not building footprints or approved building envelopes.

heightCoverage.note: Public layer has no structured building height or building footprint fields.

linkMeaning.APPLICATION_DOCUMENTS_WEBLINK: Official application documents / planning report link

license.note: City open-data page states its open data is freely available under the Open Government Licence. ArcGIS layer licenseInfo and copyrightText are blank.

pagination.method: Pinned object IDs, fetched in batches, then final status revalidation

limitations: Status labels are preserved verbatim and have no published domain definitions in this layer.
No submission or update dates in this layer.
Separate Public/Planning services showed slightly different current counts; this snapshot consistently uses the OpenData service.
boundsNote: GeoJSON bbox on each feature and collection: west, south, east, north. Bounds center is a camera reference, not a parcel centroid.
